title: TradingAgents worker protocol
description: One request or reply frame exchanged with `python -m tradingagents.opencode_worker serve`. Frames are newline-delimited JSON on stdin/stdout. Protocol version 1.

WorkerAction.description: A worker action. `ping` and `shutdown` are server control actions.

WorkerRequestFrame.description: One line on the worker's stdin.

protocol_version.description: Must match PROTOCOL_VERSION in protocol.py and worker.ts.

id.description: Client request id. Replies echo it so concurrent actions cannot be confused.

run_dir.description: Absolute run directory. Required for every action except ping and shutdown.

json_args.description: Action-specific arguments, equivalent to the one-shot --json-args file.

WorkerReplyFrame.description: One line on the worker's stdout.

id.description: The request id, or null when the request could not be parsed.

exit_code.description: One-shot exit code equivalent: 0 ok, 2 validation, 3 bad input, 4 vendor, 1 internal.
